mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) above 1300 thousand units signal strong consumer demand and economic activity, directly boosting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through increased business investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1300.0 units.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity valuations and reducing corporate borrowing capacity, which directly causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand strength, creating a multiplicative effect on corporate revenue visibility that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), wage growth pressures accelerate inflation expectations, triggering preemptive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 102.0 (index 2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing output and supply chain efficiency, supporting corporate profit margins and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1400.0 thousand units signals a housing market boom that drives consumer confidence and spending, directly causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate sectoral economic impact.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) creates a tight labor market that accelerates wage inflation, prompting preemptive monetary tightening and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through valuation compression.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain stress, reducing corporate output capacity and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.
